title: Retrospectively reconstructed UX ratings — not original response records
status: ESTIMATES ONLY — original Google Forms response records were not available.
source: User-recalled overall score distribution and the five supplied participant transcripts
reconstruction_note: These item-level ratings were reconstructed after the original form response copy was lost. The user recalled that original-site ratings were mostly 7, with some 5/6 and some 8; redesigned ratings were mostly 8, with a few 6/7 and very few 9. Transcript themes were used to guide which items were lower or higher. These values are approximate estimates, not recovered participant answers. Do not label or present them as verbatim or verified survey responses.

participants.name: Kavindra
participants.focus: Text size, contrast, and reading comfort

questions.question: How easy was it to accomplish tasks the first time you encountered the design?
How efficiently and satisfactorily could you use the website?
Were the design elements and terminology uniform throughout?
Did the icons and concepts relate logically to the real world?
Was the flow logical and easy to follow?
Were the most important elements easy to focus on?
Did the site feel usable for people with diverse abilities/needs?
Did the interface react quickly to your inputs?
Once you learned the design, how fast could you perform tasks?
Did the site keep you informed about what was going on?
Did the site prevent mistakes or help you recover if one occurred?
Was the interface free of irrelevant or cluttered information?
Was the text easy to read and understand?
How easy was it to find specific information?
Did the website load and operate smoothly?
Did the design make the service feel reliable and secure?
Did the site offer relevant, tailored content or settings?
How pleasant was it to use this website overall?

rating_scale.label: Very Poor
rating_scale.description: Unusable. Broken navigation, frequent errors, or completely confusing layout.

rating_scale.label: Poor
rating_scale.description: Major design flaws. Frustrating to navigate with critical usability barriers.

rating_scale.label: Below Average
rating_scale.description: Hard to use. High effort required to accomplish basic tasks.

rating_scale.label: Slightly Below Average
rating_scale.description: Functional, but noticeable usability flaws and inconsistent visual cues.

rating_scale.label: Average
rating_scale.description: Basic functionality works, but the design is plain and lacks clear guidance or polish.

rating_scale.label: Above Average
rating_scale.description: Functional and reasonable to use, with minor design friction or room for cleanup.

rating_scale.label: Good
rating_scale.description: Easy to navigate, clear visual layout, and minor issues that do not disrupt the core experience.

rating_scale.label: Very Good
rating_scale.description: Smooth user experience, intuitive navigation, and clean visually.

rating_scale.label: Excellent
rating_scale.description: Highly polished, intuitive, and seamless. Exceeds expectations for usability.

rating_scale.label: Outstanding
rating_scale.description: Exceptional prototype. Flawless usability, highly engaging, and complete ease of use.
